overview:
Ritchie Torres seeks reelection in a Bronx-based district that leans Democratic by 27 points. He has raised nearly $7 million and holds almost $14 million on hand, while his Republican challenger has reported no fundraising and no outside groups are spending against him. Minor-party and independent candidates trail far behind in money.

With no public polling and no expert ratings of the race, the outlook rests on fundamentals: the strong partisan lean, incumbency, and Torres's financial dominance. Prediction markets price his win at about 98 percent. The seat is rated Safe Democratic.
